verdict.rationale: The only evidence of concrete limits is a community comment citing Workers CPU-time caps (30s on the free tier, 15min on paid plans), which suggests limits are known but is not first-party documentation. AI Gateway's rate-limiting feature is a tool for controlling your own app's scaling, not a statement of the platform's documented caps. Missing for 10: a first-party limits page, documented API rate limits, documented concurrency or subrequest caps, and per-plan quota tables.
